status: proposed acceptance tests, NOT executed; owner corrected underling creation to immediate/nonblocking on 2026-11-04

cases.assertion: Unassigned visible NPC receives approved safe summary, never raw full sheet/GM fields.
Hidden unassigned NPC has no source-sheet/spell/notes/secret access.
GM grants existing actor long-lived combat and independently specified edit, inventory and progression rights.
Revoking one entitlement does not silently revoke or preserve other independent entitlements incorrectly.
A player can create a primary PC, alternate, or underling through existing Forge without an approval gate; standard account and character source permissions remain consistent until the GM edits them.

Creating an alternate/underling via create_player_character_v3 invokes v2 only once for each creation_request_id and produces one canonical character, progression, starting equipment and creation event; retry does not duplicate any.
Temporary combat authority works without can_edit, can_inventory or can_convert.
Scoped expiration or revocation denies previous cache replays under unchanged JWT.
Two authorized players share one canonical actor Action/Reaction/HP/slot ledger.
Unverifiable original requester/intent fails closed without rerun or extra spend (R1).
Wrong requester, changed target/slot/weapon/actor/encounter or lost control cannot replay.
Spellcasting profile v1 and v2 restrict spells and slots to GM-approved player projection.
get_my_player_character(s) raw to_jsonb(c) and full sheet do not leak GM secrets.
Direct RLS, SECURITY DEFINER, print/export and Realtime cannot bypass safe projection.
Combat-only equipped attack does not grant source inventory access/edit/transfer.
Equip/transfer vs attack serializes I eligibility before Reaction/HP mutation.
G revocation before action recheck denies execution/private replay without spend.
G/I row locks, FK/unique waits and deferred triggers proven on exact shared rows.
Character C→S refresh vs S→C spend does not deadlock or double spend.
Competing activation and paused→active resume cannot overlap canonical characters.
Unknown Events projection avoids hidden IDs/metadata and receives separate timing acceptance.
GM retains full original source; authorized player uses safe projection.
All directly executable legacy RPCs and readers are closed or guarded in one reviewed rollout.
R3 service principal policy explicitly approved before privileged automation.
A successful player character creation creates exactly one durable GM-visible notice from committed player_character_created event and never blocks/changes the creation.
Failed or rolled-back creation produces no Admin notice; concurrent same-request retries produce one notice.
Admin can see new/unread creation notices and mark reviewed; other player JWTs cannot call/read Admin-only event projection or receipts.
Notice shows safe creator/name/time metadata and links to the canonical character in /npcs?focus=npc:<uuid>, including a hidden player-created kind=npc character.
GM can add private notes after creation, which remain inaccessible to the creating player, other authorized combat controllers, raw sheet getters, and print/export.
GM can view, add and remove effective separately scoped control/edit/inventory/progression rights after creation; legacy grants/direct controller are correctly displayed.
A proposed capability migration preserves legacy PCs' active permissions until explicit audited change; no automatic can_edit→can_control backfill or unintended grants.
A user can hold multiple characters without players/profile/Forge overwriting prior characters or their grants; new creation leaves existing characters usable.
